text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby is so consistent after all.
...Though I was a bit worried
back during the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Looks like the next Shuka Sho won't be a problem either! Man, I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I mean... the "Illustrious Lineage"
straight up walking the royal road, isn't that like something straight out of a manga?
I hope they keep tearing it up from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Changing her route might cause a few small ripples.
But once they see her shining even brighter,
those around her will only expect even greater things.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (For a split second, something felt off with my right leg...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(...Let's wait and see for a bit.
If you're still concerned even after that—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later. Daiichi Ruby reported that her legs "felt a little off"... so we had her personal physician examine her right away.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
“—There is an acute suppurative inflammation in the right leg.
Commonly known as phlegmon.”

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured. The symptoms aren't severe.
It's thanks to you calling me right away
the moment something felt off.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: I think she'll be able to run soon, and by her next target, the Shuka Sho, she should be completely healed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have decided.
I am withdrawing my target races for the rest of the year.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
It shouldn't hinder my running that much!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As you may have gathered during the examination,
I have had a congenital issue with my legs.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, when it comes to leg issues,
I believe we must approach them with extreme caution,
regardless of how minor they may seem.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I leave the decision to enter each race
entirely in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Still... are you truly certain?
Forgive me if I am speaking out of turn, but weren't the Shuka Sho and Queen Elizabeth II Cup your dreams...?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...A dream.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am grateful for your concern.
However...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Because I already have a new "mission."

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon the interruption, Milady.
Shall I arrange a press conference immediately?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, precisely so.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It is ahead of schedule, but along with
the change in our target race... let us announce it today.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
“—To summarize everything
we've covered so far...”

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
After the Rose Stakes, an injury manifested.
While not severe, as a precaution, she would remain on light duty under observation for the rest of the year...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
is everything here in order?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean she might sit out the rest of the year...?
Are both the Shuka Sho and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup out of the question?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Well, there's always next year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup. As part of the 'Illustrious Clan,' how she performs in the Senior Class will be... quite something to see.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have one more announcement for everyone.
Regarding our next target race—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I will be running in the spring Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: "The Takamatsunomiya Kinen"...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The race that both her grandmother and mother won, huh?
In the sense of aiming for a three-generation family sweep...
I guess it makes sense, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: I see! The Takamatsunomiya Kinen is 1200m... Since that's an outright sprint, it caught me a bit off guard.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—As of this day, I, Daiichi Ruby,
hereby declare my pursuit of the sprint path.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... so does that mean
the Takamatsunomiya Kinen wasn't a one-off,
and you plan to run sprint races from now on?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Senior Triple Crown, the Autumn Senior Triple Crown...
All of the so-called "royal road" races are medium to long distance!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"You're saying... there are currently no plans
to enter any of those races?!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To become the new symbol of the "Illustrious Family"
in the sprint division.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...That is no mere dream.
A dream is hope born of uncertainty. What I have is—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—A will fulfilled by following this pride...
It is a noble mission... that only I can achieve.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Uwheh!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin...
The young lady says she's running in the sprint.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's true!
It made the news...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that refined lady did...?
That's really surprising.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, isn't that great, Helios!
Now we can run together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Helios?
Hellooo?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Yaaayyy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"My era has fiiiiiiinally arrived!!
This is it, no doubt! Next year is—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojo and I just gotta
hit it off together~~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The press conference, which had briefly descended into an uproar, concluded without further incident—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for your hard work today as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for your concern.
Everything is well within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Next year will likely be another year that demands effort, though perhaps in a different form.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
May you also walk upon
the righteous path each and every day, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Now then...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: There are still some days left before the new year, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you again next year.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next target race was decided: the Senior Spring Takamatsunomiya Kinen!
